compatibility: Local mapping, not wire-compatible production adoption; no original schema changed

mapping.evidence: SIMULATED, claim_class, original capture/receive time, evidence_id/version; separate category preserves CURRENT_STATE/HISTORICAL_FACT/USER_STATEMENT/MODEL_INTERPRETATION. Text inline and hash in audit.
mapping.context_packet: Injected principal, purpose, grant revisions, selected snapshots, no capabilities/providers; bounded serialized bytes rather than tokenizer estimates
mapping.daily_action_proposal: Only inert DRAFT_NOTE quote collection; PROPOSED, execution_enabled=false. No time/recipient/account write
mapping.agent_job: At most two timed subprocess attempts, zero provider USD and tools; ledger stores request/context/attempt/output/outcome. No broker, lease service or deployed agent
mapping.experiment: N2 local synthetic execution status distinct from frozen PROPOSED_NOT_RUN; physical permission remains NOT_GRANTED
mapping.design_artifact: N2 inert JSON dimensions only; content hash, revision, parent and metric identity; UNQUALIFIED, no CAD/toolpath/machine
